The task requires optimizing `intersection` to run in roughly linear time while preserving the order of array `a` and its deduplication logic. The diff modifies only `solution.mjs`, replacing the quadratic nested scans with O(1) Set lookups, fully satisfying the scope without touching other parts of the repository.

This change precomputes membership for array `b` in a hash set (`inB`) and tracks processed elements separately (`seen`), eliminating repeated linear scans during iteration. It reduces overall time complexity to O(n + m) while keeping identical output behavior.
